62nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1989 It increased the period of
reservation of seats provided to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes
for another 10 years ie upto 2000 AD The reservation for Anglo-Indians
through nomination in case of their inadequate representation, was also
extended upto 2000 AD:
65th Constitutional AmendmentAct,1990 (W.e.f.12.03.1992):ANational
Commission for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes with wide powers
was provided to take care of the cause of SCs / STs.
66th Constitutional Amendment Act; 1990 This amendment provided
for the inclusion of 55 new land reform Acts passed by the States into the
Ninth Schedule.
69th Constitutional Amendment Act; 1991 (w.e.f. 01.02.1992) Arts. 239-
AA and 239-AB were inserted in the Constitution to provide National
Capital Territory designation to Union Territory of Delhi with a legislative
Assembly and Council of Ministers.
70th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 Altered Art: 54 and 368 to
include members of legislative assemblies of Union Territories of Delhi and
Pondicherry in the electoral college for the election of the President:
